title: Bob Williams, cabaret work and Louisville theater
summary: Singer Lockwood Lewis and trumpeter Bob Williams are recalled; Williams let him sub in the cabaret, leading to years playing a Louisville theater whose name he cannot recall.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And we had a... Had a guy, uh... A... A... A... Very good entertainer, singer, with the band. Lockwood Lewis. He was... He was... He was very good. And, uh... Everywhere we'd go, we'd... We'd... Pretty... Pretty nice. And so I just... Just went from that and... And I began to like it, you know. I... I... I began to just, uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Stick with it, you know. And finally, this fellow was... Telling about... William. Bob Williams. He was a... Trumpet player. Man, he was very good. He was a good musician. And he played at, uh... Night clubs. And so... Finally... Uh... The... Those jobs then didn't pay too much... No one got... Money.

Yeah. But he... He played there and then whenever they had... Other... Other... Worked dances or... Something like that. They played a lot of dance work in those days. Well then he would leave and go on that because more money. Yeah. And he would put me on the... Take his place in the cabaret that night. And so that way I got... Got a little experience of playing, uh... Uh... Offering for entertainers. Sure. And so from that way I... I... I got into playing... Playing... Cabaret... And... Playing for entertainers. Yeah. And played in the... I played for... Several years in the theater... What was the... Waterville House where the pictures of Waterville... Oh yes.
Yeah. Remember the name of that theater?
Now... Let's see... They changed the name of that theater... Several... And I think it was... What? It was Dream Man Theater... I don't know... Next...
I know they changed names a lot of times that way... Yeah... Uh...
I think it was the Lyric... I just can't remember now...
But... They changed the name... How long did you stay in Louisville then... And... Doing that kind of work... And when did you leave town there? Well... After... After a few years...
